basic_info.description: Step into the timeless charm of this light-filled, four-bedroom + office, three-bathroom Victorian home, perfectly blending historic elegance with modern updates. Nestled on Elizabeth Street in the coveted Noe Valley neighborhood and just steps from the energetic yet quaint 24th Street, this beautifully maintained residence offers light filled living spaces, soaring ceilings and modern elegance. The thoughtfully designed layout features four spacious bedrooms and a dedicated office, well suited for today's work-from-home lifestyle. The chef's kitchen boasts premium appliances, ample storage, and a seamless flow into the dining and rear family room with immediate access to a large terrace and steps down to the impressively landscaped rear yard, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Whether you're hosting a summer gathering, enjoying a quiet morning coffee, or unwinding under the stars, this beautifully landscaped retreat offers the perfect blend of style and serenity. With its unparalleled charm, updated amenities, and unbeatable location, this Victorian gem is more than a homeit's a lifestyle.
